FIELDS.NAME: Granite & Surface Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Granite & Surface Solutions specializes in the installation of high-quality countertops and surfaces, offering a wide range of materials including granite, quartz, marble, and laminate. Our operations focus on providing residential and commercial clients with exceptional craftsmanship and meticulous attention to detail. We ensure that all installations comply with local building codes and safety regulations, employing trained installers who have extensive experience with the materials we handle. Each project begins with a thorough risk assessment to identify potential hazards, and we adhere to documented safety protocols throughout the installation process. We also require all subcontractors to provide proof of current liability insurance before commencing work to minimize liability exposure. Clear, written contracts are established for each project, outlining the scope, payment terms, and timelines to prevent disputes and ensure transparency. Our commitment to quality and safety has positioned us as a reliable partner in the countertop and surface installation industry.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that all subcontractors provide proof of current liability insurance before commencing work. We fully comply with all local building codes and fire safety regulations, and structural modifications are performed only with the necessary engineering oversight and permits. Additionally, our operations are free from unresolved legal disputes and a history of non-payment to vendors, ensuring our eligibility for coverage.
